cases.text: I have half a roast chicken and rice

recooked: Rinse rice according to package instructions.
Add the rinsed rice and reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer for 15-20 minutes or until the water is absorbed.
problems: “Half Roast Chicken with Rice” is the same leftovers reheated; make a different dish out of them

recipe.name: Half Roast Chicken with Rice
steps: Heat oven to 375°F.
Place the half roast chicken in a baking dish.
Bake for 30-40 minutes or until the internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Rinse rice according to package instructions.
In a saucepan, bring 2 cups of water to boil.
Add the rinsed rice and reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer for 15-20 minutes or until the water is absorbed.

recipe.name: Leftover Roast Chicken Fried Rice Bowl
steps: Chop the leftover roast chicken into bite-sized pieces.
Finely chop the green onions.
Stir the cooked eggs into the rice.
Add the chopped chicken, green onions, and grated ginger to the skillet.
Pour the soy sauce over the mixture and toss gently to combine.

cases.text: leftover pasta and some steamed broccoli

recooked: Cook the pasta according to package instructions.
Steam the broccoli for about 5 minutes until tender.
problems: “Pasta with Steamed Broccoli” is the same leftovers reheated; make a different dish out of them

recipe.name: Pasta with Steamed Broccoli
steps: Cook the pasta according to package instructions.
Steam the broccoli for about 5 minutes until tender.
Drain the cooked pasta and return it to the pot.
Add steamed broccoli to the pot with the pasta.
Season with salt, pepper, and a drizzle of olive oil if desired.

recipe.name: Creamy Pasta Broccoli Bake
steps: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a large bowl, combine leftover cooked pasta and steamed broccoli.
Season with salt, black pepper, and minced garlic.
In a separate bowl, mix grated Parmesan cheese, shredded mozzarella cheese, and breadcrumbs.
Pour the pasta and broccoli mixture into a baking dish.
Sprinkle the cheese mixture evenly on top.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until the cheese is golden brown and bubbly.

cases.text: mashed potatoes and a bit of ham

problems: “Ham and Mashed Potatoes” is the same leftovers reheated; make a different dish out of them

recipe.name: Ham and Mashed Potatoes
steps: Heat mashed potatoes in a saucepan over medium heat.
Dice the ham into small cubes.
Mix the diced ham with the heated mashed potatoes.

recipe.name: Leftover Ham and Mashed Potato Cakes
steps: In a large bowl, combine the leftover mashed potatoes, diced ham, shredded cheddar cheese, eggs, panko breadcrumbs, green onions, and smoked paprika.
Using your hands, form the mixture into 6-8 equal sized patties.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat. Add enough oil to lightly coat the surface.
Place the potato cakes in the skillet, cooking for about 4-5 minutes on each side until golden brown and crispy.
Serve immediately with your choice of sauce or garnish.

recipe.name: Chickpea Curry with Whole Wheat Rotis
steps: Soak the chickpeas overnight.
Pressure cook the soaked chickpeas with spices like cumin, coriander, turmeric and garam masala.
Once cooked, blend a portion of the chickpeas to make a smooth paste.
While the chickpea curry is cooking, prepare the whole wheat rotis.
Knead the dough and roll into small circles.
Cook each roti on a hot tawa (griddle) until it puffs up.

recipe.name: Leftover Dal Stuffed Rotis
steps: Heat a tablespoon of oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent.
Add minced garlic and garam masala. Sauté for another minute.
Stir in the leftover dal and cook for 5 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld.
Place one leftover roti on a flat surface.
Scoop a portion of the dal mixture onto the center of the roti.
Fold in the sides and roll up the roti to enclose the filling.
Repeat with remaining rotis and dal.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat. Place the stuffed rotis in the pan.
Cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until they are crispy and heated through.

cases.text: half a pot of chili and half a baguette

recipe.name: Spicy Baguette Sandwich
steps: Heat the chili on medium heat for 10 minutes.
Slice the baguette into halves lengthwise.
Spread the heated chili onto the baguette halves.
Serve immediately and enjoy!

recipe.name: Chili Baguette Bruschetta
steps: Slice the leftover baguette into 2 cm thick slices.
Cut the tomatoes into thin slices.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Crush garlic cloves and sauté until fragrant, then remove from pan but keep oil.
Add baguette slices to the oil, fry on each side for about 2 minutes or until golden brown.
Top each piece of garlic toast with a spoonful of leftover chili, followed by tomato slices.
Sprinkle Parmesan cheese on top (if using)

recipe.name: Pulled Pork Sandwich with Coleslaw
steps: Combine pulled pork and coleslaw in a large bowl.
Season with salt, pepper, and your favorite BBQ sauce.
Place the seasoned pulled pork mixture into the slow cooker.
Cook on low heat for 8 hours.
Stir occasionally for even heating.

recipe.name: Pork and Coleslaw Stuffed Bread Bowls
steps: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
Cut off the tops of the bread loaves, reserving them for another use.
Hollow out the center of each bread loaf, leaving a 1-inch thickness around the edges.
In a large mixing bowl, combine leftover pulled pork and coleslaw.
Stir in garlic powder and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Divide the mixture evenly between the hollowed-out bread loaves.
Dot each loaf with butter.
Wrap each bread bowl in aluminum foil and place on a baking sheet.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the bread is golden brown and the filling is heated through.

problems: “Roasted Vegetables and Couscous” is the same leftovers reheated; make a different dish out of them

recipe.name: Roasted Vegetables and Couscous
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Spread the roasted vegetables on a baking sheet.
Bring 3 cups of water to a boil.
Add couscous, stir well, and remove from heat. Cover and let stand for 5 minutes.
Fluff with a fork.
Mix the roasted vegetables and cooked couscous together.
Season with salt, pepper, olive oil, and lemon juice to taste.

recipe.name: Leftover Roasted Vegetable and Couscous Salad
steps: In a large bowl, combine the leftover roasted vegetables and couscous.
Drizzle with olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper. Toss until well combined.

cases.text: a cooked salmon fillet and quinoa

recooked: While the salmon is grilling, cook quinoa according to package instructions.

recipe.name: Grilled Salmon with Quinoa
steps: Preheat the grill to medium heat.
Season the salmon fillet with salt and pepper on both sides.
Grill the salmon for about 6-8 minutes per side, or until it reaches desired doneness.
While the salmon is grilling, cook quinoa according to package instructions.

recipe.name: Salmon Quinoa Salad
steps: Chop the salmon fillet into bite-sized pieces.
In a large bowl, combine the quinoa, chopped cucumber, sliced avocado, and salmon.
In a separate bowl, whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, dill, salt, and pepper to create the dressing.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss until evenly coated.

recooked: Cook taco meat according to package instructions.
problems: “Taco Bowl with Tortilla Chips” is the same leftovers reheated; make a different dish out of them

recipe.name: Taco Bowl with Tortilla Chips
steps: Cook taco meat according to package instructions.
Crush tortilla chips slightly.
Layer crushed tortilla chips at the bottom of a bowl.
Top with cooked taco meat.
Add your favorite toppings such as lettuce, tomatoes, cheese, and sour cream.

recipe.name: Taco-Stuffed Tortilla Soup
ingredients: 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed
steps: Crush half of the tortilla chips in a bowl.
Set aside the remaining whole chips.
Coarsely chop the lettuce.
Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the crushed tortilla chips and cook, stirring occasionally, until lightly toasted, about 5 minutes.
Add the leftover taco meat, black beans, and 4 cups of chicken or vegetable broth. Bring to a simmer.
Simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in the chopped lettuce until slightly wilted.
Ladle soup into serving bowls.
Top with the diced avocado and remaining whole tortilla chips.
Serve immediately.

recooked: Cook the elbow macaroni according to package directions.
problems: it must use every leftover as an ingredient, but it leaves out: mac and cheese
“Mac and Cheese with Hot Dogs” is the same leftovers reheated; make a different dish out of them
it needs 5 ingredients they'd have to buy (elbow macaroni, sharp cheddar cheese, milk, unsalted butter, bread crumbs); use at most 4 besides the leftovers and pantry staples

recipe.name: Mac and Cheese with Hot Dogs
steps: Cook the elbow macaroni according to package directions.
Drain and set aside.
Melt the butter in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Stir in mustard powder.
Gradually add milk, whisking constantly.
Add shredded cheese and stir until melted.
Mix in cooked macaroni and sliced hot dogs.
Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C).
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish.
Sprinkle bread crumbs on top.
Bake for about 20 minutes or until golden brown.

recipe.name: Hot Dog Mac and Cheese Bake
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Lightly grease a baking dish.
Cut the hot dogs into bite-sized pieces and mix them with the leftover mac and cheese.
Transfer the mixture to the prepared baking dish.
Sprinkle shredded cheddar cheese over the mac and cheese and hot dog mixture.
Beat the egg in a small bowl and drizzle it evenly over the dish.
Sprinkle breadcrumbs on top and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown and bubbly.
